description: This file defines custom UI components, type mappings for custom elements, and utility functions for a web UI library, including imports of various component modules and a function to instantiate custom elements by tag name.

classes.name: CustomElementConstructorOf
classes.description: A type describing a constructor function that returns an instance of T extending HTMLElement.

methods.name: instanceOf
methods.description: Type-safely retrieves a custom element constructor using the tagName map.
